ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65:35 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white regions dominate the central and inner areas of both lobes. A thick, irregular black pigmentation band borders the entire trailing edge and the central notch. Small, low-density dark mottling is distributed across the white regions, primarily concentrated near the transition to the black trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with an estimated angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by continuous serration; pixel-level peaks and valleys vary between 3 to 10 pixels in amplitude along the boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering slightly upward toward the lateral tips.

other_distinctive_markers: A specific cluster of high-contrast black spots is visible in the lower-mid quadrant of the white region on the right lobe.
